scope: exact MARS-S2L v3 full and test-only site benchmark for the frozen calibrated representation ensemble

architecture.available_scene_score: logit blend of site-relative spatial score at weight 0.25 and adaptive Prithvi score at weight 0.75, followed by the frozen -0.5044762783678565 logit offset
architecture.missing_scene_policy: retain the frozen adversarial diagnostic scores: zero for a missing positive and one for a missing negative
architecture.dense_mask: released MARS-S2L probability mask with frozen sensor thresholds, gated by unchanged v3 stronger scene score at the independently selected 0.75 cutoff
architecture.label_access_order: construct and persist all 43,524 available candidate scores before opening diagnostic labels

gates.average_precision: point estimate beats exact v3 and published table; paired site-bootstrap lower bound above zero
gates.matched_fpr_recall: point estimate and paired site-bootstrap lower bound above exact v3 at no worse FPR
gates.fixed_false_positive_rate: paired site-bootstrap upper bound no higher than exact v3
gates.pixel_iou: point estimate beats exact v3 and paired site-bootstrap lower bound above zero
gates.comparator_identity: recomputed v3 AP, recall, FPR, IoU, rows, sites, and positives must exactly match the hash-bound receipt

invariants: The evaluator uses the official v3 paper URL and exact reconstructed archive metrics, not an earlier revision or rounded substitute.
No paper label participates in architecture, ensemble, calibration, threshold, or dense-mask selection.
The five unavailable rows retain the adversarial missing-data policy.
All 10,000 bootstrap replicates resample physical sites and pair candidate with the exact v3 comparator.
This is transparent post-test architecture evaluation because the paper cohort was opened by predecessor experiments; it is not independent external confirmation.
Failure on any gate in either view rejects the ensemble and resumes architecture research.
